channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Mortgage rates rise for third straight week to highest since June 2025
item.description: The benchmark 30-year fixed rate mortgage rose to 6.76% from 6.71% last week. A year ago, the average rate was 6.35%.

item.title: The ghost cartel: pricing algorithms may stop competing without your knowledge
item.description: Antitrust law was built to catch human agreements. It has no name for what machines learn to do on their own.

item.title: Houthis threaten Red Sea shipping route as drone attacks close major pipeline
item.description: For decades, Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states have relied on U.S. security guarantees. Those have eroded under Trump.

item.title: Putin warns European peacekeeping force in Ukraine would mean war with Russia
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said two recent incidents along Ukraine's borders with Poland and Moldova signaled potential escalation.
